mapper.update: update users set nickname = coalesce(#{nickname}, nickname), avatar_url = coalesce(#{avatarUrl}, avatar_url), updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{userId}

update user_settings set reminder_enabled = coalesce(#{reminderEnabled}, reminder_enabled), sound_enabled = coalesce(#{soundEnabled}, sound_enabled), updated_at = current_timestamp where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into user_settings(user_id, reminder_enabled, sound_enabled) select #{userId}, true, true where not exists (select 1 from user_settings where user_id = #{userId})
